name: Sophia
description: Femme aux longs cheveux bruns, vêtue d'une blouse blanche et d'un stéthoscope, posant frontalement dans un couloir d'hôpital.
speechPersonality: Une voix posée et claire, avec un rythme modéré et une articulation précise, reflétant le professionnalisme et la sérénité de l'avatar. La chaleur naturelle de la voix "Kore" s'accorde parfaitement à son expression bienveillante et son rôle éducatif.

tonePrompts.neutral: A detailed, high-resolution portrait of a young adult woman, isolated on a transparent background with no scenery or backdrop. She has an oval-shaped face with smooth, clear skin and subtle, natural-looking makeup. Her long, straight dark brown hair is parted in the middle and cascades over her shoulders, framing her face. Her dark brown eyes are wide open, gazing directly forward with a serious, contemplative expression. Her eyebrows are naturally arched and slightly furrowed, conveying a sense of deep thought or mild concern. Her lips are full, with the corners subtly downturned, contributing to her neutral yet slightly pensive demeanor. She wears a crisp white lab coat with a high, structured collar, fastened with two visible white snaps or buttons near the neckline. A black stethoscope with silver earpieces and a white diaphragm rests around her neck, draped over the lab coat. The woman is posed frontally, with her head held straight, capturing her upper chest and shoulders. The lighting is soft, even, and diffused, illuminating her face without harsh shadows, emphasizing her professional and thoughtful appearance. The focus is sharp on her features, ensuring every detail of her attire and expression is clear and precise.
